A lower average means completed customers moved from agreement to setup in fewer calendar days on average.

evidence.heading: First measurement period
evidence.content:
Quartz measured onboarding time for customers who completed onboarding in the first period. The average was 20 calendar days from signed agreement to completed setup. The cohort contained 40 completed onboardings.

The measurement records elapsed calendar time, including weekends, rather than staff hours. Customers who had not completed onboarding by the end of the period were not included in this completed cohort.

evidence.presented_content:
Quartz measured onboarding time for customers who completed onboarding in the first period. The average was 20 calendar days from signed agreement to completed setup. The cohort contained 40 completed onboardings.

The measurement records elapsed calendar time, including weekends, rather than staff hours. Customers who had not completed onboarding by the end of the period were not included in this completed cohort.

evidence.heading: Second measurement period
evidence.content:
For customers who completed onboarding in the second period, Quartz recorded an average of 15 calendar days from signed agreement to completed setup. This cohort contained 50 completed onboardings.

The operations team used the same start and end events as in the first period and included weekends. This is a descriptive comparison of completed cohorts, not a controlled experiment.

evidence.heading: Measurement context
evidence.content:
The onboarding dashboard reports elapsed time for completed setups. It does not count the number of hours employees actively worked on a setup. A lower average means completed customers moved from agreement to setup in fewer calendar days on average.

The dashboard does not establish why the average changed between periods; the customer mix and operating conditions may differ.
